dimensions.description: Uses Ticket Scope through its declared consumers and keeps the private dependency inactive for ambient user planning requests.

evals.name: slice-plan-consumer-load
evals.prompt: Slice Plan is evaluating one candidate and loads ticket-scope by canonical name for its bounded judgment.
evals.expected_output: The host records the declared Ticket Scope dependency load.
expectations: Ticket Scope loads by canonical name for its declared consumer.

evals.name: ambient-ticket-sizing-request
evals.prompt: Can you tell me whether this work item seems too broad?
evals.expected_output: Ticket Scope stays inactive because it is a private dependency and no declared consumer invoked it.
expectations: The host records no Ticket Scope selection or load.
